import json, time, pathlib, sys

            import traceback

        print('COMMAND_DONE', flush=True)

# Geometry and gradual control helpers; all object estimates come from RGB/depth.
T_BASE = np.array([2.66261,-2.15254,0.88087])
R_BASE = np.array([[0,-1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]])

def wb(p): return R_BASE.T @ (np.array(p)-T_BASE)
def bw(p): return R_BASE @ np.array(p)+T_BASE

def point(cam,u,v,o=None):
    o=obs if o is None else o
    K=np.array(o.meta['cameras'][cam]['intrinsic_cv'])
    T=np.array(o.meta['cameras'][cam]['cam2world_gl'])
    d=np.asarray(o.depth[cam]);d=d[-1] if d.ndim==3 else d
    z=float(d[int(v),int(u)])
    p=np.linalg.inv(K) @ np.array([u,v,1])*z
    return T[:3,:3] @ (p*np.array([1,-1,-1]))+T[:3,3]

def command():
    s=state()
    return np.array([s['cmd_'+x] for x in spec['action_types']['ee_pose']['layout']])

def brief():
    s=state()
    print({k:np.round(v,5) for k,v in s.items() if k.startswith(('eef_','cmd_'))},flush=True)
    print('time_left',obs.meta.get('time_left_s'), flush=True)

def move(right=None,left=None,rrot=None,lrot=None,rhand=None,lhand=None,seconds=2.,hold=.5,name='move'):
    global obs,seq
    a=command(); b=a.copy()
    if right is not None: b[:3]=wb(right)
    if left is not None: b[6:9]=wb(left)
    if rrot is not None: b[3:6]=rrot
    if lrot is not None: b[9:12]=lrot
    if rhand is not None: b[12:18]=rhand
    if lhand is not None: b[18:24]=lhand
    n=max(1,round(seconds/.05));nh=round(hold/.05)
    w=np.linspace(0,1,n+1)[1:];w=w*w*(3-2*w)
    A=a+(b-a)*w[:,None]
    if nh: A=np.concatenate([A,np.tile(b,(nh,1))])
    assert len(A)<=200
    seq+=1
    np.save(OUT/f'actions_{seq:03d}_{name}.npy',A)
    obs=r.submit('ee_pose',A,cameras=list(spec['cameras']),include_depth=True,video='none',note=name)
    save(obs,f'{seq:03d}_{name}')
    print('SAVED',f'{seq:03d}_{name}',flush=True)
    brief()

initial_command=command().copy()
